property_summary: The admin (deployer) retains the right to call setOwner even after ownership has been transferred to a different address: for any caller equal to the deployer and any two distinct new-owner addresses, the call succeeds and owner is updated to the second address; the mutant re-authors the check against the current owner, so after ownership moves away from the deployer the same admin call reverts.
change_summary: Replace the check 'msg.sender == admin' with 'msg.sender == owner' so the owner (rather than the admin) is authorized to call setOwner.
